location.title: Location
location.intro: We love traveling and discovering magical places, and we couldn't imagine a better setting to celebrate our love than in the beautiful region of Krefeld-Linn, Germany. This special place captures the energy of connection and joy, inviting warmth, beauty, and togetherness. We want to share this unforgettable moment with our family and friends, enjoying the charming surroundings and the unique spirit that makes our celebration so special.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Once upon a time, Chris went to Colombia while Maria was living in Australia. Few years later Chris left Europe to visit Australia in the exact moment when Maria left Australia to travel in Europe (great timing, universe 👏)
story.paragraph2: Maria went to a salsa festival in Croatia looking for a soulmate. And she did find one… it was Caro. Instant best friend! Together they went to the festival three years in a row. In the fourth year Caro skipped the salsa and went to another event with her "good friend" (spoiler: that was Chris 👀).
story.paragraph3: Maria kept traveling and eventually landed at a digital nomad festival in Bulgaria. Caro messaged her: "my "good friend" is there, you should meet him!" …but never shared his contact (thanks, Caro). The universe clearly had a plan. That same weekend, Maria and Chris bumped into each other while trying to escape a busy and noisy party. They started talking, lost track of time, and didn't notice everyone else had already left.
story.paragraph4: The next morning, Maria went for a 7am run. Chris went to the park to work out. They crossed paths again… and from that moment, they never separated.
story.paragraph5: In their first year, they traveled through 14 countries together. Proof that one conversation can turn into a whole adventure. What began as "just one conversation" turned into love, adventure, and now this wedding that we are looking forward to celebrating together. 🎉💍
